description: Resident was found on the floor next to the toilet at approximately 14:30 by CNA during routine rounding. Resident was conscious and oriented to person but disoriented to time. Complained of left hip pain. No visible bleeding. Bed alarm had sounded but resident had already self-transferred from bed without waiting for assistance. Walker was across the room.
immediateActionsTaken: CNA called for charge nurse immediately. Resident was not moved. Vitals taken: BP 142/88, HR 92, SpO2 96% on room air. Charge nurse assessed and notified attending physician by phone. Family was called and is en route. Incident report initiated per protocol.
